name: Ferienwohnungen Schloss Hohenstaffing
beschreibung: The holiday apartments are located in a historic building complex on the outskirts of Kufstein, surrounded by meadows and forests. The property combines traditional architecture with modern comfort. Guests can expect generously sized apartments with fully equipped kitchenettes and separate bedrooms. Some units offer views of the surrounding mountains. Parking is available, and a small garden area is available.
